causality_contract.availability_rule: 5m delta uses trades <= bar close; BOS uses closes <= close; availability_time = signal bar close

dataset_policy.allowed: certified Binance UM aggTrades day(s) + same-provenance holding data

deduplication.rule: one open position per symbol; signals while in position ignored

direction: BOS direction with agreeing 5m delta sign (bullish BOS needs delta > 0).

entry.rule: signal at BOS bar close; market fill at next bar open
entry.timing: decision_time = BOS bar close; entry_time = next bar open

event_definition: 1m BOS bar (close beyond most-recent confirmed opposite swing extreme) with same-bar 5-minute trade delta of agreeing sign (bullish: delta > 0).
execution_model: NEXT_BAR_OPEN (certified channel; SL-first ambiguity; single position)
falsification: With sufficient evidence, pooled Cost-C expectancy <= 0 falsifies (FAIL).
mechanism: A structural break accompanied by agreeing aggressive flow is accepted initiative; a break against the flow is suspect.
research_question: Does same-direction REAL delta agreement improve BOS-break continuation?

stop.definition: Beyond BOS broken level + 0.25x ATR14 on the risk side.

threshold_provenance: Delta sign agreement is structural (no magnitude threshold to tune). BOS 3/3 + 0.25 buffer = frozen 11G conventions.
